title: Script get replaced by an embedded copy of it when editing another script in the scene that export it
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in : 4.4.stable, 4.4.1.stable, 4.5.dev2

### System information

Godot v4.5.dev2 - Windows 11 (build 22631) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 6950 XT (Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.; 32.0.11027.2001) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-13600KF (20 threads)

### Issue description

When saving a script A that `@export` another `@tool` script B in the scene that got some logic that call another class C that edit the `@export` variable from the script B, the nodes that use the script B in the scene get their script replaced with an embedded (saved in the .tscn file) copy of it

### Steps to reproduce

1 - Open the project
2 - Open the "DebugMap" scene
3 - Optional : Open the script of the "Map" node in the editor to see its name changed to "unsaved" in step 5
4 - Open the script of the "GameHandler" node in the editor
5 - Add something valid like a line break to edit the script and save it

Note : To reproduce it again, put back the "Map.gd" script on the "Map" node, discard the copy in the editor and save, then reopen the project.

Note 2 : Having the "Map.tscn" scene opened in the editor make this bug happen in the Map scene too so you may have to put back the right script in the scene too

Note 3 : After some investigation, this happen when the "MapLoader" edit the mapData of the "Map". It also does not happen if the mapData is not exported (`@export`)
